name: Virginia

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines need irrigation or deep soil that stores winter rain, but disease is rare.
Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

soil.rock: Sandstone is sand bound into rock. It weathers to light, sandy soil that drains freely.

land: The high ground runs about 5°F cooler than the low ground. Higher vineyards ripen later and keep more acidity, so one grape can make lighter or richer wine here depending on height.

winkler: Good for generous crops of standard to good wine.
